## Verdict

missing

## Bearer

ProfileViewModel — app-phone/src/main/java/com/mgilli/hyroxtracker/ui/profile/ProfileViewModel.kt

## Trigger

The link between the phone and the watch being established (no such event exists in the codebase today; would need a connectivity-state source to call into ProfileViewModel).

## Today

ProfileViewModel.onSyncClicked is the only caller of ProfileSyncPushService.push, fired solely by the "Synchroniser avec la montre"/"Réessayer" tap on the profile screen. Nothing in the codebase observes the phone-watch connection becoming established (no such event or listener exists anywhere in core-domain, core-data, app-phone or app-wear). A failed push only sets syncState to ProfileSyncUiState.Failure and stops — no retry is scheduled or attempted at a later connection.

## Expected

Establishing the link between the phone and the watch also calls ProfileSyncPushService.push, with no button tap needed. A push refused or failed at that point is retried automatically the next time the link is established, rather than staying failed until the user taps "Réessayer".
